items.headline: Scottie Scheffler's Dominant Win
items.text: Scottie Scheffler won The American Express at -27, finishing four shots ahead of Jason Day, Ryan Gerard, and Matt McCarty, who all tied at -23.

items.headline: Aaron Rai Takes PGA Championship
items.text: Aaron Rai secured the PGA Championship with a -9 final score, beating Jon Rahm and Alex Smalley who tied at -6 by three strokes.
